name: dsb-mun-5-mcp
title: DSB MUN 5.0 Model Context Protocol Server
description: Exposes DSB MUN 5.0 conference data, committee agendas, schedule, and delegate rules as tools for AI agents.

tools.name: get_conference_info
tools.description: Returns basic details about DSB MUN 5.0 (dates, venue, theme, stats)

tools.name: list_committees
tools.description: Lists all 9 committees (UNHRC, UNSC, Lok Sabha, AIPPM, UNGA, UNCSW, IP, IPL Auction, UNCLOS) with agendas and eligibility

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Returns the hour-by-hour schedule for Day 1 (1 Aug) and Day 2 (2 Aug)

tools.name: get_dress_code
tools.description: Returns delegate dress code protocol (Day 1: Indian Traditional, Day 2: Western Formal)

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: Returns contact details for Secretariat and leadership
